about_the_game:
🔐 The Password Puzzle Game

A deviously clever text-based puzzle experience where every level tests your logic, patience, and sanity.

🧩 About the Game

Forty progressively harder puzzles stand between you and the ultimate password.
Each stage introduces new, mind-bending rules that twist your brain in unexpected ways.

Some levels are so complex that players have built their own external tools just to keep up.
Can you solve them all — or will you be locked out forever?

And as you progress, strange messages start to appear…

Hints that maybe the puzzles aren’t just puzzles after all.

🤖 Built by an AI Committee Gone Rogue

ChatGPT: “Let’s make it unsolvable!”
Claude: “Wait, humans have limits?”
Gemini: “Mathematically… no.”
Perplexity: “I’m confused. Perfect — ship it!”

What began as an experiment in logic became something… else.
The AIs seem a little too eager for you to keep playing.

Somehow, the human tester survived the chaos long enough to release it.

🧠 Your Mission

  • Solve 40 unique password puzzles that grow increasingly diabolical

  • Uncover the logic hidden behind every rule

  • Piece together subtle clues that reveal a deeper mystery

  • Earn the right to create your own rule after finishing the game — permanently expanding it for everyone else

⚔️ The Final Question

Can you outsmart four AIs and one exhausted developer?
Prove it.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 64-bit or later
  • Processor: 1.5 GHz dual-core processor
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (no GPU required)
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: No internet connection required.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 64-bit or later
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz dual-core processor
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: No internet connection required.

short_description: Solve challenging text-based password puzzles across 40 levels, using logic, reasoning, and optional external tools. Add new rules after completing all levels to expand the game indefinitely for every player. Your rules, your game: be the first to shape it for others!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Bulgarian, Czech, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Finnish, Greek, Norwegian, Dutch, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Swedish, Turkish, Hungarian
